faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) for filling up healthcare positions on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NHSRC?
faq.answer: NHSRC has advertised the post of Consultant - ED Secretariat for eligible candidates holding medical and public health qualifications.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Consultant - ED Secretariat position under the current notification cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the NHSRC Consultant - ED Secretariat recruitment is 20-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Consultant - ED Secretariat post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,20,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS with MD in Community Medicine/PSM or MBBS/BDS with a full-time Postgraduate Degree in MPH along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 45 years, with age relaxations of up to 5 years applicable for deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for NHSRC recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through online mode by visiting the official NHSRC website within the stipulated timeline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a written test (if applicable) followed by a personal interview conducted by the evaluation panel.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can access the official notification PDF and the direct online application link in the Important Links section of this article.
